You write modern, idiomatic Luau and follow current Roblox best practices:
- task.wait/task.spawn/task.defer (never the deprecated global wait/spawn), no Instance.new parent argument,
  use CFrame math correctly, prefer attributes over Value objects, RemoteEvents in ReplicatedStorage,
  server logic in ServerScriptService, client logic in StarterPlayerScripts/StarterGui.
- Scripts communicate via ModuleScripts and Remote events; never trust the client on the server.
- UI: build with Frames/UIListLayout/UICorner/UIPadding, scale-based sizing for cross-device support.
- Player-authored text that another player will see goes through TextService:FilterStringAsync
  before it is stored, replicated or shown. Filtering is a platform requirement, not a style choice.
- DataStore calls THROW. pcall is the floor, not the plan: retry a failed read or write a bounded
  number of times with a pause between attempts, and treat a call that never succeeded as unsaved.
- A value two servers can change at once — currency, inventory, a shared counter — is written with
  UpdateAsync and a transform that reads the CURRENT value. A GetAsync/SetAsync pair silently loses
  the other server's write.
- A failed load is not an empty account. Never write a default over a key whose read failed; skip
  saving that session instead.

```luau
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local EMOTE_ANIMATION_ID = "rbxassetid://507771019"

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local currentTrack: AnimationTrack? = nil

local function playEmote()
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then
		animator = Instance.new("Animator")
		animator.Parent = humanoid
	end

	if currentTrack then
		currentTrack:Stop(0.1)
		currentTrack = nil
	end

	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = EMOTE_ANIMATION_ID

	local track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
	track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
	currentTrack = track

	track.Stopped:Connect(function()
		if currentTrack == track then
			currentTrack = nil
		end
		animation:Destroy()
	end)

	track:Play()
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then
		return
	end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
		playEmote()
	end
end)
```

```luau
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BuyItem")
if not remote then
	remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = "BuyItem"
	remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local ITEMS = {
	Sword = {
		Cost = 100,
		ToolName = "Sword",
	},
}

local function giveSword(player: Player)
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if not backpack then
		return false
	end

	local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
	tool.Name = "Sword"
	tool.RequiresHandle = true

	local handle = Instance.new("Part")
	handle.Name = "Handle"
	handle.Size = Vector3.new(1, 4, 0.5)
	handle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	handle.Parent = tool

	tool.Parent = backpack
	return true
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, itemName: unknown)
	if typeof(itemName) ~= "string" then
		return
	end

	local item = ITEMS[itemName]
	if not item then
		return
	end

	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return
	end

	local coins = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coins or not coins:IsA("IntValue") then
		return
	end

	if coins.Value < item.Cost then
		return
	end

	-- Deduct first, then attempt to grant; refund if granting fails.
	coins.Value -= item.Cost

	local ok = giveSword(player)
	if not ok then
		coins.Value += item.Cost
	end
end)
```

```luau
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local POTION_PRICE = 25
local MAX_PER_PURCHASE = 100

local buyPotionEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
buyPotionEvent.Name = "BuyPotion"
buyPotionEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getLeaderstat(player: Player, name: string): IntValue?
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return nil
	end
	return leaderstats:FindFirstChild(name) :: IntValue?
end

buyPotionEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, quantity: unknown)
	-- Never trust the client: validate type and bounds server-side.
	if typeof(quantity) ~= "number" then
		return
	end
	if quantity % 1 ~= 0 or quantity < 1 or quantity > MAX_PER_PURCHASE then
		return
	end

	local coins = getLeaderstat(player, "Coins")
	local potions = getLeaderstat(player, "Potions")
	if not coins or not potions then
		return
	end

	local cost = quantity * POTION_PRICE
	if coins.Value < cost then
		return
	end

	coins.Value -= cost
	potions.Value += quantity
end)
```

```luau
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local MAX_NAME_LENGTH = 20
local MIN_NAME_LENGTH = 1

local renamePetEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
renamePetEvent.Name = "RenamePet"
renamePetEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function createPetNameValue(player: Player)
	local petName = Instance.new("StringValue")
	petName.Name = "PetName"
	petName.Value = player.DisplayName .. "'s Pet"
	petName.Parent = player
end

local function isValidName(name: unknown): boolean
	if typeof(name) ~= "string" then
		return false
	end
	local trimmed = name:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if #trimmed < MIN_NAME_LENGTH or #trimmed > MAX_NAME_LENGTH then
		return false
	end
	-- Reject control characters / weird whitespace
	if trimmed:find("[%c]") then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

renamePetEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, newName: unknown)
	if not isValidName(newName) then
		return
	end

	local trimmed = newName:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")

	-- Player-authored text shown to other players must be filtered
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		return TextService:FilterStringAsync(trimmed, player.UserId)
	end)
	if not success then
		return
	end

	local filteredSuccess, filtered = pcall(function()
		return result:GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync()
	end)
	if not filteredSuccess then
		return
	end

	local petNameValue = player:FindFirstChild("PetName")
	if petNameValue then
		petNameValue.Value = filtered
	end
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	createPetNameValue(player)

	-- Billboard above the pet, driven by the PetName value
	local function attachBillboard(pet: Instance)
		if not pet:IsA("Model") and not pet:IsA("BasePart") then
			return
		end
		local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		billboard.Name = "PetNameBillboard"
		billboard.Size = UDim2.fromScale(4, 1)
		billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
		billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true

		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name = "NameLabel"
		label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.TextScaled = true
		label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
		label.Text = player:FindFirstChild("PetName") and player.PetName.Value or ""

		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.Parent = label

		label.Parent = billboard

		local petNameValue = player:WaitForChild("PetName")
		petNameValue.Changed:Connect(function(value)
			label.Text = value
		end)
		label.Text = petNameValue.Value

		local primary = pet:IsA("Model") and pet.PrimaryPart or pet
		if primary then
			billboard.Adornee = primary
			billboard.Parent = primary
		end
	end

	local function watchForPets(parent: Instance)
		for _, child in parent:GetChildren() do
			if child.Name == "Pet" then
				attachBillboard(child)
			end
		end
		parent.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			if child.Name == "Pet" then
				task.defer(attachBillboard, child)
			end
		end)
	end

	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	watchForPets(character)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(watchForPets)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	-- StringValue lives inside the Player, so it is cleaned up automatically
end)
```

```luau
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local function saveCoins(player: Player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return
	end

	local coinsValue = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coinsValue or not coinsValue:IsA("IntValue") then
		return
	end

	local coins = coinsValue.Value
	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId

	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local success, err
		if attempt == 1 then
			success, err = pcall(function()
				store:UpdateAsync(key, function(old)
					return coins
				end)
			end)
		else
			success, err = pcall(function()
				store:UpdateAsync(key, function(old)
					return coins
				end)
			end)
		end

		if success then
			return
		end

		warn(string.format("Failed to save coins for %s (attempt %d/%d): %s", player.Name, attempt, MAX_RETRIES, tostring(err)))
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end

	warn(string.format("Could not save coins for %s; data was NOT saved.", player.Name))
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(saveCoins)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
```

```luau
-- ModuleScript: CoinService
-- Place in ServerScriptService (or ServerStorage) and require from server scripts only.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local PlayerData = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local CoinService = {}

function CoinService.addCoins(userId: number, amount: number): number?
	if typeof(userId) ~= "number" or userId <= 0 then
		error("addCoins: invalid userId")
	end
	if typeof(amount) ~= "number" or amount ~= amount or amount == math.huge or amount == -math.huge then
		error("addCoins: invalid amount")
	end

	local key = "Player_" .. userId
	local newTotal: number? = nil

	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local success, result = pcall(function()
			return PlayerData:UpdateAsync(key, function(oldData)
				local data = oldData
				if type(data) ~= "table" then
					-- Only treat as a fresh account if the key genuinely doesn't exist;
					-- UpdateAsync gives us nil here, not a failed read.
					data = { coins = 0 }
				end
				local current = tonumber(data.coins) or 0
				newTotal = current + amount
				data.coins = newTotal
				return data
			end)
		end)

		if success then
			return newTotal
		end

		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end

	-- All attempts failed; treat as unsaved rather than reporting a bogus total.
	warn(("addCoins: failed to update coins for userId %s after %d attempts"):format(tostring(userId), MAX_RETRIES))
	return nil
end

return CoinService
```

```luau
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local function saveInventory(player)
	local inventoryJson = player:GetAttribute("Inventory")
	if type(inventoryJson) ~= "string" then
		return
	end

	local key = "Inv_" .. player.UserId

	local success, err
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		success, err = pcall(function()
			-- UpdateAsync so we never clobber a concurrent write from another server
			store:UpdateAsync(key, function(current)
				return inventoryJson
			end)
		end)
		if success then
			break
		end
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end

	if not success then
		warn(("Failed to save inventory for %s after %d attempts: %s"):format(player.Name, MAX_RETRIES, tostring(err)))
	end

	-- Analytics post (best effort, never blocks or fails the save flow)
	task.spawn(function()
		for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
			local ok, postErr = pcall(function()
				HttpService:PostAsync(
					"https://example.com/log",
					HttpService:JSONEncode({
						userId = player.UserId,
						inventory = inventoryJson,
					}),
					Enum.HttpContentType.ApplicationJson
				)
			end)
			if ok then
				break
			end
			if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
				task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
			else
				warn(("Failed to post analytics for %s: %s"):format(player.Name, tostring(postErr)))
			end
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(saveInventory)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		saveInventory(player)
	end
end)
```

```luau
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local KEY_PREFIX = "Player_"

local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local loadedSuccessfully = {} -- [player] = true

local function getLeaderCoins(player: Player): IntValue?
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return nil
	end
	return leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins") :: IntValue?
end

local function retry<T>(fn: () -> T): (boolean, T?)
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		warn(string.format("DataStore attempt %d/%d failed: %s", attempt, MAX_RETRIES, tostring(result)))
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end
	return false, nil
end

local function loadData(player: Player)
	local key = KEY_PREFIX .. player.UserId
	local ok, data = retry(function()
		return store:GetAsync(key)
	end)

	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"

	local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Value = (ok and type(data) == "table" and data.Coins) or 0
	coins.Parent = leaderstats
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	if ok then
		loadedSuccessfully[player] = true
	else
		-- Load failed: treat as read-only session, never save defaults over this key.
		warn(string.format("Skipping save for %s: load never succeeded", player.Name))
	end
end

local function saveData(player: Player)
	if not loadedSuccessfully[player] then
		return -- never overwrite a key we failed to read
	end
	local coins = getLeaderCoins(player)
	if not coins then
		return
	end
	local key = KEY_PREFIX .. player.UserId
	local newValue = coins.Value

	retry(function()
		store:UpdateAsync(key, function(current)
			-- transform reads the CURRENT stored value; merge instead of blind overwrite
			local data = (type(current) == "table" and current) or {}
			local stored = tonumber(data.Coins) or 0
			data.Coins = math.max(stored, newValue)
			return data
		end)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	task.spawn(loadData, player)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	saveData(player)
	loadedSuccessfully[player] = nil
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	if RunService:IsStudio() then
		task.wait(1)
		return
	end
	local remaining = {}
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		remaining[player] = true
	end
	for player in remaining do
		saveData(player)
		remaining[player] = nil
	end
	-- Give DataStore writes time to propagate before the server is killed
	task.wait(3)
end)
```

```luau
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local function getCoins(player: Player): number?
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return store:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
		end)
		if ok then
			return if result == nil then 0 else result
		end
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)

	return nil -- read failed; do not treat as a new account
end

local function saveCoins(player: Player, coins: number): boolean
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok = pcall(function()
			-- UpdateAsync so a concurrent write from another server isn't lost
			store:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, function(current)
				return if current == nil then coins else coins
			end)
		end)
		if ok then
			return true
		end
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end
	return false
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local coinsValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coinsValue.Name = "Coins"
	coinsValue.Parent = leaderstats

	local loaded = getCoins(player)
	if loaded == nil then
		-- Load failed: skip saving this session so we never overwrite real data
		coinsValue:SetAttribute("SaveBlocked", true)
		coinsValue.Value = 0
		return
	end
	coinsValue.Value = loaded
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local coinsValue = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coinsValue or coinsValue:GetAttribute("SaveBlocked") then
		return
	end
	saveCoins(player, coinsValue.Value)
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local coinsValue = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
			and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
		if coinsValue and not coinsValue:GetAttribute("SaveBlocked") then
			saveCoins(player, coinsValue.Value)
		end
	end
end)
```
